dossier.body:
# About you

You are new to running. You started in late August, at 41, to get fitter, and want to run the whole of the Corrowmore Harvest 5K on Sunday 15 November without walking. You run three mornings a week (Monday, Wednesday and Saturday), walk-run for now, and walk the dog most days. You have not run since school. No injuries.
